title: Embed the four bee agent bodies so the dispatch renderer can read them at runtime
action: The four rendered bee agents (bee-build, bee-gather, bee-extract, bee-review) live only as on-disk templates read at ONBOARDING time (packages/bee-rs/crates/bee/src/onboard/agents.rs:142 reads engine.templates_agents_dir). The dispatch renderer needs their bodies at RUN time. (1) Move `split_frontmatter` out of onboard/agents.rs:176 into packages/bee-rs/crates/bee/src/textutil.rs as `pub(crate) fn split_frontmatter(&str) -> (&str, &str)` with its doc comment intact, and make onboard/agents.rs call the moved copy — exactly ONE parser must exist afterwards. (2) In packages/bee-rs/crates/bee/src/verbs/drivers/prompt.rs add four consts beside the existing PROMPT_* block (prompt.rs:33-39), each `include_str!("../../../../../../bee/agents/bee-<name>.md.tmpl")`, and `pub(crate) fn embedded_agent_body(agent_name: &str) -> Option<&'static str>` that matches on "bee-build"|"bee-gather"|"bee-extract"|"bee-review", splits the frontmatter off with the moved helper, and returns the trimmed body — None for every other name including "general-purpose". Do NOT change any existing prompt const, load_prompt, normalize_template, or prompt_skew behavior. Do NOT touch prepare.rs — that is hab-2.

truths: textutil.rs holds the ONLY split_frontmatter in the crate; onboard/agents.rs calls it and defines no copy
embedded_agent_body("bee-gather") returns a body starting "You are a bee gather worker" and containing no "---" frontmatter delimiter
embedded_agent_body("general-purpose") and embedded_agent_body("nonsense") both return None
a new unit test in drivers covers one Some case and one None case
cargo build succeeds: the four include_str! paths resolve from prompt.rs

trace.outcome: Embedded the four bee agent bodies in prompt.rs and moved split_frontmatter to textutil.rs as the single parser
